newsitem.title: INDONESIA: General Electric unit in Indonesia venture.
newsitem.headline: General Electric unit in Indonesia venture.

text.p: General Electric Lighting, a unit of General Electric, announced a merger on Wednesday between its Indonesian operation and local company PT Sinar Baru Electric (SiBalec) to sell lighting products.

"This merger will strengthen our business by combining General Electric's expansive global capabilities with SiBalec's local expertise," Paul Morse, president director of the new company, PT GE Lighting Indonesia, told a news conference.
GE Lighting is the biggest shareholder in the new venture with an over 50 percent stake, Morse said. He gave no further details.
PT Sibalec is Indonesia's second-largest light fixture manufacturer.
General Electric Lighting opened a factory in Surabaya, Indonesia's second city, in 1994 and currently have around $50 million invested in the country, Morse said.
